governance.rationale: Closes the Governance approval readback gap identified in Dev closure evidence 20260904 and training-session/persona_target.py. Enforces that session_id, candidate_digest, proof_digest, controller_record_ref, recorded_at, and authority_status == "authoritative" are returned on decided approvals. Authority flags are stamped strictly by the governance controller when outcome is approved/approved_with_conditions and are never filled from untrusted request metadata.

runtime.rationale: BFF runtime creation in services/control-plane/bff/runtime/router.py dispatches through RuntimeManagerClient.deploy() when read_store lacks create_runtime_binding, eliminating direct mutation-through-read-surface dependency.

personas.rationale: Persona updates and creation in services/control-plane/bff/personas/service.py and routes/detail.py route through _get_active_write_owner() (PersonaRegistryHttpWritePort) before falling back to read_store.

research.rationale: In personas/service.py, create_research_ticket routes through research_knowledge_source port or build_research_write_owner. In research/routes/experiments.py, create_experiment routes through research_knowledge_source port or build_research_write_owner, while experiment logs, metrics, and artifacts queries gracefully handle ReadSurfacePorts.

jobs.rationale: In jobs/router.py, get_job_logs safely inspects read_store for get_job_logs_bff, preventing AttributeErrors against pure ReadSurfacePorts.

implementation.read_surface_invariants_preserved: ReadSurfacePorts in services/control-plane/bff/ports/read_surface_ports.py is completely unmodified and maintains zero mutation methods, adhering strictly to RETAINED_WRITES_DEFERRED_FROM_READ_SURFACE.
